questions.stem: The client's sister asks the nurse, "Does my brother have AIDS? Nobody will tell me." The client has not given permission to share health information. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.

options.text: Tell the sister that the nurse cannot share the client's health information

Offer to support the client if they choose to tell the family
Explain the diagnosis to the sister since she is a close relative
Leave the chart open at the station so the family can read the results

rationale.correct: HIV information is shared only with the client's consent.

perOption.d: HIV status needs specific consent to share.

exhibits.title: Emergency department
exhibits.body: A 38-year-old client has had 3 weeks of dry cough, fever and breathlessness that is worse on exertion. The client has lost 7 kg and has white plaques in the mouth. The client tested HIV positive 5 years ago but never started treatment. The client's sister is at the bedside.

exhibits.title: Rheumatology clinic
exhibits.body: A 26-year-old client with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) stopped hydroxychloroquine 2 months ago because of cost. The client has painful swollen hands, a facial rash after a beach holiday, ankle swelling and foamy urine.

caseStudies.title: Rheumatoid arthritis biologic therapy with reactivated tuberculosis

exhibits.title: Admission
exhibits.body: A 58-year-old client with rheumatoid arthritis takes methotrexate 20 mg once weekly, folic acid and adalimumab every 2 weeks. The client has had 6 weeks of night sweats, a cough and 4 kg weight loss. The client was born in a country where TB is common. A latent TB test before adalimumab was not found in the chart.

exhibits.title: Surgical ICU
exhibits.body: A 64-year-old client is on day 12 after a bowel resection with total parenteral nutrition through a central line and broad-spectrum antibiotics. New fever and hypotension developed overnight despite the antibiotics.
